<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; text-indent:36pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Form N-PX is to be used by a registered management investment company, other than a small business investment company registered on Form N-5 (&#167;&#167; 239.24 and 274.5 of this chapter), to file reports with the Commission, not later than August 31 of each year, containing the registrant&#146;s proxy voting record for the most recent twelve-month period ended June 30, pursuant to section 30 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 and rule 30b1-4 thereunder (17 CFR 270.30b1-4). &nbsp;The Commission may use the information provided on Form N-PX in its regulatory, disclosure review, inspection, and policymaking notes.</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; text-indent:36pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A registrant is required to disclose the information specified by Form N-PX, and the Commission will make this information public. &nbsp;A registrant is not required to respond to the collection of information contained in Form N-PX unless the Form displays a currently valid Office of Management and Budget (&#147;OMB&#148;) control number. &nbsp;Please direct comments concerning the accuracy of the information collection burden estimate and any suggestions for reducing the burden to the Secretary, Securities and Exchange Commission, 450 Fifth Street, NW, Washington, DC 20549-0609. &nbsp;The OMB has reviewed this collection of information under the clearance requirements of 44 U.S.C. &#167; 3507.</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; text-indent:36pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&nbsp;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; text-indent:36pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&nbsp;</P>
<HR style="padding-top:7.2pt; padding-bottom:7.2pt" noshade size=1.333>
<P style="margin:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:12pt"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>ITEM 1. PROXY VOTING RECORD:</B></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; text-indent:36pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Disclose the following information for each matter relating to a portfolio security considered at any shareholder meeting held during the period covered by the report and with respect to which the registrant was entitled to vote:</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a). The name of the issuer of the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b). The exchange ticker symbol of the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c). The Council on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (&quot;CUSIP&quot;) number for the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d). The shareholder meeting date;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e). A brief identification of the matter voted on;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&nbsp;(f). Whether the matter was proposed by the issuer or by a security holder;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g). Whether the Registrant cast its vote on the matter;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h). How the Registrant cast its vote (e.g., for or against proposal, or abstain; for or withhold regarding &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;election of directors); and</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&nbsp;(i). Whether the Registrant cast its vote for or against management.</P>
<P style="margin:0pt; line-height:13pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><BR></P>
